about.title: About PDF to Word Converter
about.description: The PDF to Word Converter is an advanced online tool that transforms PDF documents into editable Word formats (DOC/DOCX) with exceptional accuracy. This converter is essential for professionals, students, and businesses who need to edit, modify, or repurpose content from PDF files while maintaining original formatting and layout. Converting PDF to Word format enables you to edit text, modify layouts, add comments, and collaborate on documents that were previously locked in PDF format. Our converter uses advanced OCR technology to handle both text-based and scanned PDF documents with high precision.

faq.q: Can the PDF to Word converter handle scanned documents?
faq.a: Yes, our PDF to Word converter includes advanced OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology that can extract text from scanned PDF documents and convert them into editable Word format with high accuracy. This works for both image-based PDFs and scanned documents.

faq.q: Will the original formatting be preserved during PDF to Word conversion?
faq.a: Our converter is designed to maintain original formatting, including fonts, styles, tables, and layout structure. While complex layouts may require minor adjustments, most formatting is preserved accurately during the PDF to Word conversion process.

faq.q: What's the difference between DOC and DOCX output formats?
faq.a: DOCX is the newer XML-based format that offers better compatibility, smaller file sizes, and enhanced features with modern Microsoft Word versions. DOC is the legacy format compatible with older versions of Microsoft Word. We recommend DOCX for most users.

faq.q: Are there file size limits for PDF to Word conversion?
faq.a: Our PDF to Word converter efficiently handles various PDF sizes. For optimal performance, we recommend files under 100MB, though larger documents are supported with extended processing time. Complex documents may take longer to convert.

faq.q: Is my document data secure during the conversion process?
faq.a: Yes, all PDF to Word conversions are processed securely with client-side processing where possible. Your documents are not stored on our servers, ensuring complete privacy and data security throughout the conversion process.

faq.q: Can I convert password-protected PDF files to Word?
faq.a: Yes, our converter can handle password-protected PDF files. You'll need to provide the password during the upload process, and the conversion will proceed while maintaining the security of your document content.
